title: A Normative Framework for Benchmarking Consumer Fairness in Large Language Model Recommender Systems
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It focuses on consumer fairness related to demographic attributes like age and gender in recommender systems.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it is not a focus of the research.
